Clay is a crafting material generally used to produce ceramics and repair kits. Its acquisition is unlocked after obtaining the [[Building (Tech Tree)|Concept of Dirt]] [[technology]] from the [[Bishop]].

Clay can be obtained from holes using a [[shovel]]. Two can be found just south of your [[graveyard]].

== Location ==
[[File:Land clay spot 1.png|This is how the clay pits look like|link=mining]]
*2x clay pits south of the [[graveyard]], near the [[river]]
*2x clay pits near the [[potter]]'s house, in the south of the [[village]]
